project.name: Cloud Resource Manager (aggregator)
project.description:
Root aggregator. Builds all services with one command (NFR-1, NFR-6). It is NOT a parent: each service inherits spring-boot-starter-parent directly and carries its own Maven wrapper, so every service is independently buildable and runnable.
All seven deployable services are listed below, in unit order: U1 (Prajwal) quota, resource U2 (Karan) billing-service U3 (Vinayak) provider U4 (Siddharth) notification-service, usage-aggregator, expiry-worker
